data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Orchard Capital Management's most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in FIP and NODK.

On September 28, 2026, FIP entered into a material definitive agreement, according to an 8-K Item 1.01 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1899883/000114036126037763/ef20082849_8k.htm).

I can share the free weekly issue and a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
